name: Vaults of the Inquisition Normal trash hits a level 25 player as hard as in the June 2026 Normal log
contract: Vaults of the Inquisition (map 936) Normal creatures are level 59-60 and DestinyWeaver scales each blow to the viewer's level (finder entry 401, band 10-59). #9826 tuned their Normal DamageModifier so that no Normal hit at 60 exceeds Heroic, which left a level 25 player taking 5-12 per blow. The Normal combat log of 2026-06-06 (level 25 group) shows median non-crit melee of 49 from Inquisitorial Torturer (162733) and 78 from Darkandle Brute (162763). The class 1 average blow at level 25 is (11.7485 * 1.25 + 86 / 14 * 2) * 1.5 (CoA.CreatureScaling dungeon damage) = 40.5 per point of DamageModifier, so the Normal templates carry 1.211 and 1.928. script_melee_hit_taken averages the creature's own blows through the melee range hooks, the done/taken bonuses and DestinyWeaver's view of a level 25 player, before armor.
